name: agent-stack
description: Production patterns for building agent orchestrators — and for billing the LLM access they burn.

plugins.name: agent-stack
plugins.description: Patterns from a production multi-agent system: tool-calling loops with context-pressure handling, multi-stage pipelines with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and resume, multi-provider LLM routing with fallback and health checks, a four-layer memory system with confidence decay and conflict resolution, and the wallet side — tiered balances, a single markup boundary, two-phase commit against a provider API with compensating transactions, spend-delta polling, and budget/loop/auto-pause guardrails.
